results.title: A push to recognize a Cleveland house Olympic gold medalist Jesse Owens called home
results.description: Jesse Owens' family home, located in Cleveland's Fairfax neighborhood, was designated a historic landmark in 2024, but efforts continue to preserve the site for future generations.

results.title: Cowboys rookie defensive back Caleb Downs is living up to expectations while learning two spots
results.description: Expectations are high for Dallas Cowboys rookie defensive back Caleb Downs, the No. 11 overall draft pick who is being counted on to help overhaul their defense.
